scene.title: Nativity climax and final confrontation
scene.summary: At the Nativity, the Devil attempts revenge. The Magi, Joseph, Mary, Kashim, and the restored protagonist fight possession and work to save the infant Jesus before the story returns to 1995.
scene.choices: Caspar, Melchior, and Balthazar use dignified diction. The Devil's archaizing self-importance contrasts with the protagonist's blunt modern voice.
